 A Deep Dive Into Jon Hamm's Marriage & Wife Amid Baby News
 Alyssa Norwin Thu, November 19, 2026 at 11:08 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Jon Hamm and Anna Osceola attend Apple TV+'s "Your Friends & Neighbors" New York Premiere - Theo Wargo/Getty Images Jon Hamm and his wife, Anna Osceola , are parents!
 The 55-year-old Mad Men actor has become a dad for the first time, per People . Hamm and his wife, who have a 17-year age gap, have welcomed a baby boy, just two months after Osceola debuted her baby bump on the Emmys red carpet.
 "I hope [marriage] turns into kids," Hamm told The Hollywood Reporter in 2024. "I will be the old dad, but so it goes. It could be a good thing." That hope has come to fruition. Now that the Hamm family has grown by one more, get to know the actor's wife and get the full rundown on their relationship history.
 Who is Jon Hamm's wife?
 Osceola is an actress who was born in Massachusetts and eventually moved to Los Angeles to pursue her career. She has acting credits in Saving Grace , Rizzoli & Isles , In Plain Sight , NCIS , Law & Order: SVU , Law & Order: True Crime , Curb Your Enthusiasm , Animal Control , Confess , Fletch , and, most notably, Mad Men .
 How did Jon Hamm meet his wife?
 The now-couple met on the set of Mad Men in 2015. Osceola starred in one episode of Hamm's hit series — the series finale. She played a receptionist named Clementine who worked at a retreat that Hamm's character, Don Draper, attended.
 Jon Hamm and Anna Osceola attend the 2025 Vanity Fair Oscar Party Amy Sussman / Getty Images
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Although Hamm and Osceola were first spotted spending time together off-camera in 2017, they weren't romantically linked until they popped up together again in 2020. Their relationship was confirmed later that year, but they didn't make their first official red carpet appearance as a couple until 2022.
 When did Jon Hamm get married?
 Hamm and Osceola privately got engaged. The news broke in February 2023, although it was reported at the time that The Morning Show star had popped the question "a while back." He eventually opened up about the proposal with The Hollywood Reporter , admitting, "I just remember feeling, 'This is really scary.' Then going, 'Well, it probably means it's worthwhile.'"
 The lovebirds tied the knot in Big Sur, California, in June 2023, then went on a honeymoon in Mallorca, Spain.
 "My wedding day was perfect," he gushed. "Everybody I love was there. It was so emotional, and it felt right. I was like, 'Okay, I guess this is a thing.' We did it [where they had shot the Mad Men finale], which was also amazing. Again, it was like a reset, a reboot, a reframe, a reimagining, nine years later, almost to the day. "
 Advertisement Advertisement He continued, "Obviously, my parents were not married long, so I don't have a model to look at and go, 'Oh, this is how one finds happiness.' I just knew at a certain point I wanted to be with this person. But when I proposed, I was terrified. I was like, 'What am I doing?'"

 Does Jon Hamm have kids?
 Hamm and Osceola had their first child in November 2026. Neither had children in past relationships.
 Who is Jon Hamm's ex?
 Hamm's ex is Jennifer Westfeldt . They were together for 18 years before they split in 2015. The two met in 1997 at a mutual friend's birthday party. They announced their split in a joint statement in September 2015, just months after Hamm completed treatment for alcohol abuse.
 Actors Jon Hamm (L) and Jennifer Westfeldt attend the PEOPLE Magazine Awards Jason Merritt/Getty Images
 Advertisement Advertisement "With great sadness, we have decided to separate, after 18 years of love and shared history," the exes' statement said. "We will continue to be supportive of each other in every way possible moving forward."
 After their breakup was announced, a source told Us Weekly that Hamm and Westfeldt "definitely tried" to make their relationship work, but there had "always been a rift" since "he wanted kids, and she didn't."
 Hamm made a rare comment about the breakup in a 2017 interview with InStyle , telling the mag, "It's fine. It's hard. It's hard to be single after being together for a long time. It's really hard. It sucks."
